## Apis

- [Recently Deprecated[#](#recently-deprecated "Link to this heading")](https://scikit-plots.github.io/dev/apis/deprecated.md): To be removed in 0.5
- [APIs Reference[#](#apis-reference "Link to this heading")](https://scikit-plots.github.io/dev/apis/index.md): 🌱 Scikit-plots APIs
- [scikitplot.\_externals[#](#module-scikitplot._externals "Link to this heading")](https://scikit-plots.github.io/dev/apis/scikitplot._externals.md): Externals.
- [scikitplot.agent[#](#module-scikitplot.agent "Link to this heading")](https://scikit-plots.github.io/dev/apis/scikitplot.agent.md): Bounded, audited tool use: a planner proposes, the runtime disposes.
- [scikitplot.annoy[#](#module-scikitplot.annoy "Link to this heading")](https://scikit-plots.github.io/dev/apis/scikitplot.annoy.md): Public Annoy Python API for scikitplot.
- [scikitplot.api[#](#module-scikitplot.api "Link to this heading")](https://scikit-plots.github.io/dev/apis/scikitplot.api.md): Scikit-plots Functional API module.
- [scikitplot.cexperimental[#](#module-scikitplot.cexperimental "Link to this heading")](https://scikit-plots.github.io/dev/apis/scikitplot.cexperimental.md): C-Experimental modules for Scikit-Plots.
- [scikitplot.cexternals[#](#module-scikitplot.cexternals "Link to this heading")](https://scikit-plots.github.io/dev/apis/scikitplot.cexternals.md): C-External libraries vendored for high-performance extensions for Scikit-Plots.
- [scikitplot.cleanprompt[#](#module-scikitplot.cleanprompt "Link to this heading")](https://scikit-plots.github.io/dev/apis/scikitplot.cleanprompt.md): Redact sensitive values from a prompt, then restore them from the reply.
- [scikitplot.config[#](#module-scikitplot.config "Link to this heading")](https://scikit-plots.github.io/dev/apis/scikitplot.config.md): Configuration module for the package.
- [scikitplot.corpus[#](#module-scikitplot.corpus "Link to this heading")](https://scikit-plots.github.io/dev/apis/scikitplot.corpus.md): Tools for turning files, URLs, media, and text sources into canonical…
- [scikitplot.cython[#](#module-scikitplot.cython "Link to this heading")](https://scikit-plots.github.io/dev/apis/scikitplot.cython.md): A lightweight runtime Cython development kit with caching, pinning, garbage collection, and templating support.
- [scikitplot.datasets[#](#module-scikitplot.datasets "Link to this heading")](https://scikit-plots.github.io/dev/apis/scikitplot.datasets.md): Utilities to load popular datasets and artificial data generators.
- [scikitplot.decile[#](#module-scikitplot.decile "Link to this heading")](https://scikit-plots.github.io/dev/apis/scikitplot.decile.md): Visualizing predictive model insights for enhanced business decision-making.
- [scikitplot.exceptions[#](#module-scikitplot.exceptions "Link to this heading")](https://scikit-plots.github.io/dev/apis/scikitplot.exceptions.md): Custom warnings and errors used across scikit-plots.
- [scikitplot.experimental[#](#module-scikitplot.experimental "Link to this heading")](https://scikit-plots.github.io/dev/apis/scikitplot.experimental.md): Experimental submodules for Scikit-Plots.
- [scikitplot.externals[#](#module-scikitplot.externals "Link to this heading")](https://scikit-plots.github.io/dev/apis/scikitplot.externals.md): External dependencies vendored for stability and reproducibility for Scikit-Plots.
- [scikitplot.impute[#](#module-scikitplot.impute "Link to this heading")](https://scikit-plots.github.io/dev/apis/scikitplot.impute.md): Transformers for missing value imputation.
- [scikitplot.levenshtein[#](#module-scikitplot.levenshtein "Link to this heading")](https://scikit-plots.github.io/dev/apis/scikitplot.levenshtein.md): Levenshtein distance facade with safe optional acceleration.
- [scikitplot.logging[#](#module-scikitplot.logging "Link to this heading")](https://scikit-plots.github.io/dev/apis/scikitplot.logging.md): [`logging`](#module-scikitplot.logging "scikitplot.logging") (alias, [`logger`](../modules/generated/scikitplot.logger.html#module-scikitplot.logger…
- [scikitplot.mcp[#](#module-scikitplot.mcp "Link to this heading")](https://scikit-plots.github.io/dev/apis/scikitplot.mcp.md): Composable documentation retrieval for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.
- [scikitplot[#](#module-scikitplot "Link to this heading")](https://scikit-plots.github.io/dev/apis/scikitplot.md): An intuitive library that seamlessly adds plotting capabilities and functionality to any model objects or outputs, compatible with tools like scikit-learn…
- [scikitplot.memmap[#](#module-scikitplot.memmap "Link to this heading")](https://scikit-plots.github.io/dev/apis/scikitplot.memmap.md): MemMap: file-backed or anonymous memory mapping.
- [scikitplot.mlflow[#](#module-scikitplot.mlflow "Link to this heading")](https://scikit-plots.github.io/dev/apis/scikitplot.mlflow.md): `MLflow UI | SERVER` share the exact same settings.
- [scikitplot.nc[#](#module-scikitplot.nc "Link to this heading")](https://scikit-plots.github.io/dev/apis/scikitplot.nc.md): NumCpp: A Templatized Header Only C++ Library with Implementation of the Python NumPy-Compatible API.
- [scikitplot.preprocessing[#](#module-scikitplot.preprocessing "Link to this heading")](https://scikit-plots.github.io/dev/apis/scikitplot.preprocessing.md): Methods for scaling, centering, normalization, binarization, and more.
- [scikitplot.random[#](#module-scikitplot.random "Link to this heading")](https://scikit-plots.github.io/dev/apis/scikitplot.random.md): Random Number Generation (Numpy-Like [`Generator`](https://numpy.org/devdocs/reference/random/generator.html#numpy.random.Generator "(in NumPy v2.6.dev0)"))…
- [scikitplot.rank\_bm25[#](#module-scikitplot.rank_bm25 "Link to this heading")](https://scikit-plots.github.io/dev/apis/scikitplot.rank_bm25.md): Various BM25 algorithms for document ranking.
- [scikitplot.seaborn[#](#module-scikitplot.seaborn "Link to this heading")](https://scikit-plots.github.io/dev/apis/scikitplot.seaborn.md): Seaborn-style scikit-plots plotting.
- [scikitplot.stats[#](#module-scikitplot.stats "Link to this heading")](https://scikit-plots.github.io/dev/apis/scikitplot.stats.md): Elegant statistical tools for intuitive and insightful data visualization and interpretation.
- [scikitplot.utils[#](#module-scikitplot.utils "Link to this heading")](https://scikit-plots.github.io/dev/apis/scikitplot.utils.md): Various utilities to help with development.
- [scikitplot.visualkeras[#](#module-scikitplot.visualkeras "Link to this heading")](https://scikit-plots.github.io/dev/apis/scikitplot.visualkeras.md): visualkeras \_graph.py
